prompt-idle-walk.txt EXACT ISSUED PROMPT:
Create NEW original-reference-based 2D hand-painted game sprite animation for ONLY the ivory floating many-eyed tentacle creature in the supplied reference, TWILIGHT normal monster "질투의 감시자 알비온" (Albion watcher). This is newly authored motion, NOT recovered original frames. Preserve its distinctive broad compact mantle-like body, flowing milky WHITE/IVORY fleshy tendrils with faint lavender shading, ornate GOLD rims around many small purple/blue eyes, and ONE prominent vertical MAGENTA central FRONT eye with narrow turquoise pupil inside the gold pointed central socket. The creature is an organic ivory many-eyed floating mass, NOT a brown spherical seer, NOT a human, NOT a hooded person or robe, NOT an octopus with a round bald head. No mouth added. No staff, arms, human legs or equipment. Main body and every eye-bearing tendril remain organically ATTACHED. Keep the original wide-to-height proportion approximately 1.1:1; small gold-rimmed eyes are distributed organically down branching attached tendrils. Preserve the original ivory/magenta/gold palette and painterly dimensional detail, no cartoon simplification.
ALL 8 direction columns in exact order LEFT TO RIGHT: E (true RIGHT-facing profile), SE (front-right 3/4), S (direct FRONT facing screen DOWN/viewer), SW (front-left 3/4), W (true LEFT-facing profile), NW (rear-left 3/4), N (direct BACK facing screen UP/away), NE (rear-right 3/4). E and W show genuinely foreshortened side anatomy: central magenta front eye is narrow at the leading edge, NOT a full face pasted on a side. N shows the ivory rear mantle and back surfaces of attached curling tendrils; NO central front magenta eye visible through the back, NO front face/mouth. Rear3/4 directions show appropriate rear anatomy. S shows the actual central magenta front eye and many gold-rimmed small eye-tendrils. Each direction is independently rendered anatomy, not a simple flipped copy.
Pixel structure: fully TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no drawn ground, no shadow, no glow, no beams, no aura, no detached particles or pieces, no text, no labels, no grid, no empty frame. EXACT equal grid. Every complete creature must fit VERY SMALL inside its cell, at most 40 PERCENT of BOTH cell width and cell height, with enormous wholly transparent gutters surrounding all sides. Include ALL tendril tips in each connected full-body silhouette and never touch any cell edge. Use EXACT SAME head/body scale, center and floating/contact anchor within every cell. Do not hide lower tendrils by cropping. Organic anatomical animation must change actual tendril curvature, eye socket aim, mantle flex and body twist; simply translating, scaling, rotating or repeating one still does not qualify. No duplicate visible poses.
FIRST SHEET: EXACTLY 8 columns x 5 rows = EXACTLY FORTY whole-body poses. Landscape 1536x1024 canvas, 8 equal192px columns and5 equal approximately205px rows. Each character is only about75px wide x70px tall, centered safely in its cell; at least55px clear left/right and65px clear top/bottom. Keep FULL actual creature detail despite small poses.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM:
ROW1 IDLE A: relaxed ivory mantle, downward softly hanging curling eye-tendrils, alert central eye in appropriate front/side views.
ROW2 IDLE B: visibly distinct breathing flex of ivory mantle; side eye-tendrils curl inward while lower tendril tips unfurl; actual changed S-curve anatomy, not moving the same still.
ROW3 WALK A: floating propulsion stroke A toward the column's exact direction. Leading attached tendrils extend/uncurl toward movement direction while opposite trailing tendrils curl under the mass. Body remains complete and connected.
ROW4 WALK B: passing/compression stroke. Leading tendrils sweep backward under body while the opposite cluster begins to open, visibly reversed bend from row3. Gentle organic mantle compression, no scale change.
ROW5 WALK C: opposite propulsion stroke. Alternate attached tendril cluster extends while the first returns, with unmistakably different bend/overlap/eye socket aim versus rows3 and4. A real three-phase floating locomotion cycle, not the identical floating pose shifted up or down.
Every row needs all eight directional whole-body figures, forty independently articulated poses total. Do not include attack, hit or death on this sheet.
